answer: Each identity climbs three layers before earning at the wharf. Layer one buys a 40-credit wharf pass, key-bound and logged. Layer two locks a 70-credit garden bond for 20 epochs, slashed on cheating. Layer three needs a 100-credit saffron seal, one per identity and non-transferable. Forging 1,000 identities costs 45,000 in fees plus 210,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and reclaims its bonds after 20 clean epochs.
